## Context

Placeholder. Epic c6de-76e7-5e4b-4968 ships a LiteLLM-backed provider abstraction in `dso_ci_review/providers/` that supports Anthropic + OpenAI. Adding Gemini was deliberately deferred from that epic for two reasons: (1) the migration was already large enough to warrant its own scrutiny, and (2) LiteLLM has a known multi-cache-control translation bug for Gemini (https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/17201) that needs to be evaluated before we depend on it. This epic adds Gemini as a third provider once that translation issue's status is verified (resolved upstream, or worked around in our caching strategy).

## Status

Placeholder. Requires `/dso:brainstorm` before `/dso:preplanning` — scrutiny pipeline will validate that adding Gemini is genuinely a config-only change (the SC2 promise from the parent epic) versus requiring code changes in `dso_ci_review/providers/`. Likely additional scope: caching strategy for Gemini given LiteLLM issue #17201, function-calling schema differences, and any system-prompt semantic differences that need normalization.

## Anticipated Scope

- New provider entry under `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/providers/` for Gemini.
- New config key (`model.provider=gemini`) plus per-tier model identifiers in `dso-config.conf`.
- API key plumbing (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) in CI workflow + onboarding docs.
- Caching strategy verified: either LiteLLM #17201 is resolved upstream and standard `cache_control` works, or this epic implements a Gemini-specific caching path (single breakpoint instead of two; or skip caching for Gemini and accept the cost delta).
- Integration test exercising Gemini end-to-end against fixture diffs.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: c6de-76e7-5e4b-4968 (this epic adds a third provider entry to the abstraction shipped by Epic A).
